svg.title: How we work: The person decides what done means. The builder is not the judge. Reward hacking is the normal failure. If it is not measured, it is a preference. Build in public.

g.text: THE PERSON DECIDES WHAT DONE MEANS.
THE BUILDER IS NOT THE JUDGE.
REWARD HACKING IS THE NORMAL FAILURE.
IF IT IS NOT MEASURED, IT IS A PREFERENC…
